knowledge_gaps: Training targets contribute to their own transition counts. This is permitted training-data use, but singleton edges can appear supported during training without independent user evidence. Training coverage and margin improvements may therefore overstate generalization; distinguish total support from support excluding the current user.

The near-zero sigmoid amplitude initialization gives a small parameter gradient, while correctly ranked positives may already have saturated BCE gradients. The report does not establish whether the scalar will learn a useful inference-time contribution.

The ablations do not separate fixed transition reranking from changes induced by jointly retraining SASRec. A frozen-backbone residual control would help establish whether architectural integration adds value. Originality 4/10 may be generous without comparison to established sequential association-rule and recency-weighted item-neighborhood methods.

The revised report omits paired uncertainty analysis and precise coverage definitions. Nine checkpoint bundles create selection uncertainty on only 200 validation users per category. Equal wall-clock caps also permit different optimizer-update counts, so matched compute does not fully isolate the residual's effect.

follow_up_queries.reason: Determine whether transition support reflects evidence from other users and identify an affordable diagnostic for training-only shortcuts.
follow_up_queries.query: In sequential recommendation using distinct-user adjacent-transition counts and smoothed transition lift, how do leave-one-user-out statistics or user-level cross-fitting address training examples contributing to their own features? Find methods for comparing ordinary versus user-excluded edge coverage, especially singleton edges, without using held-out interactions.

follow_up_queries.reason: Clarify the closest precedents and whether a nearly zero learned amplitude can reliably improve rankings under the unchanged SASRec BCE objective.
follow_up_queries.query: For SASRec augmented with a fixed positive clipped log-transition-lift residual aggregated over five recent items, what sequential association-rule, item-kNN, or FOSSIL baselines are closest? What controls distinguish frozen-backbone reranking from joint training, and how does a sigmoid residual amplitude initialized at 0.01 affect gradient learning under saturated binary cross-entropy logits?

follow_up_queries.reason: Strengthen evaluation without changing the pinned benchmark or exceeding the shared compute budget.
follow_up_queries.query: For recommendation model selection using sampled HR@10 with 200 users per dataset, four equally weighted datasets, and three variants evaluated at three checkpoints, what paired user-bootstrap and selection-bias reporting practices are appropriate? How should equal-GPU-time comparisons also report optimizer updates and epochs to distinguish computational overhead from ranking improvements?
